attributes.action: Stop the councils from restricting the display of the national standards.
attributes.background: We want you to stop restricting our use of our national standards.

rejection.details:
There are national rules that councils may simply be adhering to (link below) - but insofar as councils may be making decisions above and beyond them it is not the Government's responsibility.

https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/flying-flags-a-plain-english-guide
